video_title: Was Punishment For Kawhi Severe Enough?  Winners & Losers Of NBA Decision On Clippers

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's $700,000 fine for improper payments to his camp
quotes.excerpt: He pays 700,000 restitution. And by the way, that was for them paying for flights and hotel rooms.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I want to talk about some of the people who come out of this who seem like they came out of this okay. Start with Kawhi. He pays 700,000 restitution.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: And by the way, that was for them paying for flights and hotel rooms and stuff that they weren't supposed to pay for outside of his contract, not for any of these endorsement deals.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's massive undisclosed payments from Dectronics and Boingo Wireless
quotes.excerpt: This report says that Kawhi was paid $21 million by Dectronics, the insurance company and Boingo Wireless.
quotes.quote: This report says that Kawhi was paid $21 million by Dectronics, the insurance company and Boingo Wireless by 2021. Then he does the deal with Aspiration and he got paid for a couple of years on that. So he is up dozens of millions of dollars. And so he pays 700,000 and here is the thing, he doesn't get suspended because 700,000 is like two games, two and a half games.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors would have extended Kawhi Leonard regardless of the trade
quotes.excerpt: If the trade happens, do you think the Raptors are still extending him? Of course.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: If the trade happens, do you think the Raptors are still extending him? Of course. You are not giving up two first-round picks to not extend the guy.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim McMahon
text_blocks.text: This dude is getting extended. And he is going where he wants to go.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lawrence Frank's six-month suspension for improper conduct
quotes.excerpt: He got six months and not a year for singing like a canary.
quotes.quote: He got six months and not a year for singing like a canary. In the case of Minnesota back in the day, Kevin McHale had to go out for a year with no pay. They call it a leave of absence, they didn't call it suspension, but he got a year with no pay. Lawrence Frank, despite the Clippers not doing that well the last couple years to the point where they basically started a blowup this last season, he got a contract extension.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Gillian Zucker and Lawrence Frank's direct culpability in Clippers misconduct
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers' most senior executive, President of Business Operations Gillian Zucker and President of Basketball Operations Lawrence Frank.
quotes.quote: The Clippers' most senior executive, President of Business Operations Gillian Zucker and President of Basketball Operations Lawrence Frank are primarily and directly culpable for this misconduct. So they basically are saying those are the two guilty parties. Zucker lies to the investigators, covers up, whatever, she gets a year's pay, a year suspension, a year's pay. Lawrence Frank cooperates, he gets six months.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's 2019 signing with the Clippers and Raptors' reaction
quotes.excerpt: In 2019, Kawhi signs with the Clippers. The Raptors are crying bloody murder.
quotes.quote: In 2019, Kawhi signs with the Clippers. The Raptors are crying bloody murder, they are crying foul saying that Uncle Dennis was asking for the sun, the moon and the stars.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Uncle Dennis's demands for Kawhi Leonard's endorsement money
quotes.excerpt: Uncle Dennis calls up the Clippers and says, y'all promised me that you would get Kawhi some money.
quotes.quote: During COVID, Uncle Dennis, according to this report, calls up the Clippers and says, y'all promised me that you would get Kawhi some money, some endorsement money. You brought me some BS deals because remember there was the previous jersey ad, the previous jersey sponsor before Aspiration, Kawhi did have a deal and he did perform commercials for them and it was for some pittance of money. I want real bogus deals, don't give me fake bogus deals.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lawrence Frank taking notes on Uncle Dennis's demands
quotes.excerpt: Lawrence Frank takes notes on the call and saves them.
quotes.quote: Lawrence Frank takes notes on the call and saves them. I have talked to many agents and executives who refer back to, they are like, well, you told me two weeks ago about this. And I was like, damn, they are taking notes on what I am telling them. So it is not unheard of in the NBA, but Lawrence Frank takes them. And then within, while the world is shut down, you think Dectronics is selling many new scoreboards in the pandemic?

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers' trade for Kawhi Leonard as a disastrous sports deal
quotes.excerpt: You've just got to dig yourself out of the rubble of one of the most disastrous deals.
quotes.quote: The damage is done. You've just got to dig yourself out of the rubble of one of the most disastrous deals in sports history. I mean, this thing ended up being, like it's up there with the Herschal Walker trade. When you start stacking up picks and stuff, guys like Emmit Smith and Darren Woodson and like it was like a whole bunch of dudes. But Emmit Smith and Shai, you know, just start there. And that deal was all the picks and this deal you gave up an MVP plus all the picks.
